svg.title: An illustrative house call
svg.desc: Illustrative exchange, drawn as a retro game dialogue. You: my PC takes three minutes to boot since last week. IT reads the boot log (level 0, read-only), names a first hypothesis, then asks before disabling one startup app (level 1, needs your yes). You choose yes. Journal: boot time from 170 s to 42 s, measured after a real restart.
